title: Cosmonauts Survived a Rocket Explosion at 17 Times Gravity

scenes.text: A rocket exploded under two cosmonauts, and they survived.
It was 1983. Fire broke out at the base of their Soyuz rocket, right before launch.
Ground control fired the escape rocket seconds before the blast.
It yanked their capsule away with up to 17 times the force of gravity.
The booster below exploded, and its remains burned on the pad for nearly 20 hours.
Both men survived. A rocket exploded under them, and they walked away.

description:
A rocket exploded under two cosmonauts in 1983, and the escape rocket pulled them to safety.
They felt up to 17 g for about five seconds as the capsule was yanked away.
Could you handle 17 g?
first_comment: Would you ride a rocket knowing it could explode on the pad?
